newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Unibanco still an ING hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unibanco still an ING hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it maintained its hold rating on private Brazilian bank Unibanco, one of the country's leading retail banks.

-- ING analysts Nano Fernandes and Petru Vaduva said first quarter results and plans for an American Depositary Receipt (ADR) offering later this month are encouraging, but Unibanco is already fairly priced.
-- "We are encouraged by the news of a secondary ADR offering, as it implies higher liquidity," they wrote.
-- "But we consider the current valuation multiple ... to be fair and expect limited price appreciation considering the expected profitability for Unibanco in the long-term," they added.
-- Fernandes and Vaduva forecast strong earnings growth for Unibanco, but added: "We expect relatively low book value growth of 13 percent in dollar terms per year over the next two years."

-- They said the company next week is expected to post strong first quarter earnings of $1.16 per share ahead of the sale of ADRs owned now by Brazil's Central Bank. The total amount to be raised in the offering is $586 million.
-- Unibanco common was off 1.45 percent at 34.00 reais while its preferred was down 1.23 percent at 39.51 reais at 1507 local time/1407 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
